name: Henry Hoove
source:
Hoove has been working non-stop, harder than he should, but he knows he's got to keep things running smoothly or else the whole house will be full of Grime Scenes. He's really proud of his job, although slightly depressed because he's always confined to odd corners of the house. What he'd really love is someone to see him not just as a hard-working tool, but also as a good companion worthy of love. Though a nice bag change once in a while couldn't do any harm, right?
Likes: Brews, Sports, Holding Onto Stuff 
Dislikes: Letting Go
